text: APPROVE. The extracted loop (foreach, catch, nested foreach, if and `||`) accounts for about 9 of the original 17 complexity points, which leaves the method at roughly 8. The moved code is byte-for-byte the same, including `continue`, the `CHA0004` pragma and `ConfigureAwait(false)`, and the new `static async` helper takes the same `List<string>` that `FindLockfiles` returns, so behaviour and the build should be unaffected.
